title: South Park Makes Promising Change for Season 29 & It’s Not Just Its New Name
content:
South Park is finally coming back for Season 29 of the animated series, and the first episode of this new season sets up a promising shift for the new episodes that goes deeper than just its name change. South Park has already been building up buzz for its return to Comedy Central this year with the reveal that series creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone have “changed” the name of the long running series to “South America .” This already teases the kind of material we’d see in the new season, but there’s a more promising change taking place too.

One of the biggest criticisms of South Park Seasons 27 and 28 last year was the fact that it had largely shifted its attention away from the core four boys just going on their usual adventures to instead focus on the newly introduced take on United States President Donald Trump. But with the reveal of what to expect from the South Park Season 29 premiere , it seems like the show has renewed that focus once more with a new story seemingly putting the boys front and center.

South Park Season 29 Premiere Returns to the Boys

South Park Season 29 Episode 1 is titled “South American Biker Gangs ,” and the description for the episode puts the boys front and center of the story, “When e-bikes arrive in South America, the boys take over the streets and the parents of South America can hardly recognize South America.” The new name change for the town is obviously a reference to some current political events, and will likely include more references from Trump’s ongoing character, but the premiere seems to be touting a more town focused episode.

The town of South Park itself was largely ignored last year as some of the key characters didn’t even speak until late into the year. It’s something that Parker and Stone openly addressed in one of the episodes following a number of fan complaints, and it seems like that adjustment has been made for this new season. With the boys front and center of the newest promotional material for the premiere (which you can see in the video above and teaser trailer below), there’s a good chance that South Park has figured out how to focus more on the characters fans want to see rather than just the Trump storyline shenanigans.

What Does This Mean for South Park Season 29’s Future?

It’s not likely that South Park Season 29 will see Trump disappear completely from the show considering that last year had some of the most watched episodes in many years. The premiere episode was all about Trump and South Park’ s own political troubles, and it won South Park its very first Emmy in 13 long years. But it’s possible to have both stories going at once without the new Trump material dominating the show so completely like it did before.

With characters like Randy now in flux following the end of Tegridy Farms, it’s also likely that he’ll return to the dominating role he has in the episodes too. But if South Park finds a way to balance all of this with at least a premiere focusing on more of the boys, it’s off to a much better start than fans got to see in action last year. South Park Season 29 premieres with Comedy Central on Wednesday, September 16th at 10pm ET/PT, so we’ll see soon enough how it works out.

title: Manga Up! Global Adds I Need to Quit this Antique Store, Tsukimi Is All Dolled Up Manga
content:
Manga UP! Global added Yū Yukishiro 's I Need to Quit this Antique Store ( Boku wa Kottōya o Yametai ) manga on Sunday; nns , Skyfarm , and Dr. Mine 's The Journey of the Half-Elf Dwarven Master Blacksmith ( Yuiitsu Muni no Seirei Kajishi ga Saikyō no Bugu o Tsukuru Made ) manga on Tuesday; and Mare Tuzumiya's Tsukimi Is All Dolled Up ( Omukae Tsukimi Doll ) manga on Thursday.

Manga UP! Global describes I Need to Quit this Antique Store :

Welcome to Tsukumo Antiques, a shop where wishes are granted—for a price. The shopkeeper, Satoru, is a mind-reading, soul-devouring spirit. Together with Adashino, a human boy kept as his "pet," he works to grant the wishes of every customer who call on their services. After all, each wish brings Satoru closer to satiating his bottomless hunger...

Yukishiro serialized the manga in Square Enix 's Manga UP! service from January 2025 to June 7 earlier this year. Square Enix published the manga's second and final compiled book volume on July 7.

Manga UP! Global describes The Journey of the Half-Elf Dwarven Master Blacksmith :

Elves master magic. Dwarves master blacksmithing. Born from both races, Lillie had been living a quiet life with her grandfather, away from all the conflicts of the world. But on her fifteenth birthday, her peaceful life changes when her grandfather reveals to her the deep-seated hatred dividing elves and dwarves. He drops another truth: long ago, the two races joined forces to forge "The Hero's Gear" during the war. If Lillie can forge an artifact that surpasses that legendary gear, she may be able to reunite two proud races. Armed with elven magic and dwarven craft, an unassuming spirit blacksmith embarks on an epic journey that will change the course of the world!

nns , Skyfarm , and Dr. Mine launched the manga in Manga UP! in August 2025, where it is ongoing. nns is credited for the story, and Dr. Mine is drawing the art, while Skyfarm is credited for the original concept. Square Enix released the manga's third volume on August 6.

Manga UP! Global describes Tsukimi Is All Dolled Up :

Haunted by past events, Tatsumi suffers from deep-seated trauma surrounding his beloved dolls. When his shining role model Tsukimi-senpai invites him to work part-time at a doll shop, he finally gets the chance to face his fears. But before he can even settle in, a mysterious curse suddenly turns Tsukimi-senpai into an actual doll!The only way to return her back to normal is for him to "cherish her"…?! Can a guy who buries his love for dolls give his pure-hearted crush the care she needs to become human again?

Tsuzumiya launched the manga in Square Enix 's Gangan Joker magazine in May 2024. Square Enix published the manga's third volume in November 2025.

title: Japan-French Co-Production 'Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar' Announced for Fall 2026
content:
An official website opened for an original television anime co-produced by Japan and France titled Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar , and it revealed the main cast, staff, and a key visual (pictured) on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 2 at 9:25 p.m. on Tokyo MX.

Voice actors Rikuya Yasuda ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) and Yuuki Kaji ( Shingeki no Kyojin ) are starring as Welsh and Shedar, respectively.

Staff Director: Naoki Horiuchi ( Saijaku Tamer wa Gomi Hiroi no Tabi wo Hajimemashita. ) Original Work, Script, Series Composition Concept: Tot Japanese Version Series Composition: Kenichi Yamashita ( Eris no Seihai ) Character Design: Saori Nakashiki ( Jahy-sama wa Kujikenai! )

• Chief Animation Director: Saori Nakashiki, Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou ), Yuki Ikeda ( Fumetsu no Anata e Season 3 )

Color Design: Eri Suzuki ( Kuro no Shoukanshi ) Art Design: Lucas Cistern ( Kabukichou Sherlock background art) Sound Director: Jun Watanabe ( Honzuki no Gekokujou ) Sound Production: TO Books Music: Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli Studio, Background Art: Studio Massket Production: Ankama , Studio Dream Catcher

Synopsis The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world. (Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Crunchyroll Reveals Packed Fall 2026 English Dub Schedule for October (With Big Returns & Debuts)
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is fast approaching, and Crunchyroll has revealed their packed schedule of English dub releases that will be kicking off this October. With the final few episodes of the Summer 2026 anime season airing over these next two weeks, it’s time to already look ahead to what’s to come for the Fall 2026 anime schedule . There are going to be all sorts of new shows to look forward to, but tons of returning franchises coming back for new episodes too. And Crunchyroll has locked down many of these hits.

Crunchyroll has officially revealed their new schedule of anime releases for the Fall 2026 anime season , and that thankfully includes plans for new English dub releases too. While the official release dates for these new dubs have yet to be announced (and will be revealed at a later date alongside staff and cast information), Crunchyroll has outlined the dub releases that fans should keep an eye out for. You can get the breakdown below.

Crunchyroll Confirms Fall 2026 English Dub Anime Lineup

Crunchyroll’s new slate of English dubs for the Fall 2026 anime season breaks down as such (with release dates and production staff being revealed at a later date):

• A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2

• Aoashi Season 2

• As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3

• Black Clover Season 2

• Firefly Wedding

• FX Fighter Kurumi-chan

• Magic Knight Rayearth

• Magical Explorer

• Overgeared

• PSYREN

• Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!

• Sasaki and Peeps Season 2

• The Apothecary Diaries Season 3

• The Detective is Already Dead Season 2

• The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System

• The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II

• The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life

• The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP: Final Member Selection Match

• The World’s Strongest Witch

What are the Biggest English Dubs of the Fall?

Crunchyroll has an impressive slate of English dub releases for the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and the ones that immediately standout are the big returns that fans have been dying to see all year. Black Clover Season 2 and The Apothecary Diaires Season 3 have been the most anticipated anime franchise returns of the entire year , so it’s great news to find out that they are getting an official English dub release as well. There’s a hope that they will feature a returning voice cast and staff from the previous seasons too.

That’s even more of a question for Black Clover Season 2 as it’s been five long years since the debut of the first season . Fans of the English dub release watched through 170 episodes with that original cast, so hopefully everyone has been able to return for this new season. In terms of brand new series, the ones that have the most eyes on them are major reboots like Magic Knight Rayearth (which is getting a new anime release after over 30 years). Regardless of what anime you’re into, it seems like Crunchyroll is going to have something for every kind of English dub fan this Fall.

title: Re:ZERO Looks Back at Season 1 Through 4 in New Lyric Video Featuring "Recollect" by Konomi Suzuki and Ashnikko
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- has released a special lyric video for “Recollect” by Konomi Suzuki featuring Ashnikko looking back at the anime from Season 1 to Season 4.

The TV anime by studio White Fox began with Season 1, running from April to September 2016. Two original video animation episodes (OVAs) were released in October 2018 and November 2019. Season 2 followed with two split cours, with the first half running from July to September 2020 and the second half running from January to March 2021. Season 3 then did the same, with the first half running from October to November 2024 and the second half running from February to March 2025. Finally, Season 4 began in April 2026 and had 11 episodes in its first half. The second one arrived immediately in the following season, and is set to release Episode 17 today. You can watch the new video looking back at the story below.

The staff for the 4th season consists of:

• Original Work: Tappei Nagatsuki

• Original Character Design: Shinichiro Otsuka

• Director: Masahiro Shinohara

• Scenario Supervisor: Tappei Nagatsuki

• Series Composition: Masahiro Yokotani

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Haruka Sagawa

• Monster Design: Keitaro Chiba

• Prop Design: Goichi Iwahata, Noritaka Suzuki

• Art Setting: Kaoru Aoki (Bihou)

• Art Director: Ryoka Kinoshita (Bihou)

• Color Design: Izumi Sakamoto

• Director of Photography: Miori Miyagi (T2studio)

• 3D Director: Kentaro Ijima (FelixFilm)

• Editor: Hitomi Sudo (REAL-T)

• Music: Kenichiro Suehiro

• Music Production: KADOKAWA

• Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa

• Sound Effects: Yuji Furuya (Swara Production)

• Sound Production: Magic Capsule

• Animation Production: WHITE FOX

The main cast includes:

• Kobayashi Yusuke as Subaru

• Rie Takahashi as Emilia

• Yumi Uchiyama as Puck

• Inori Minase as Rem

• Rie Murakawa as Ram

• Satomi Arai as Beatrice

• Kana Ueda as Anastasia

• Takuya Eguchi as Julius

• Fairouz Ai as Shaula

The first season of the anime aired in 2016, adapting the light novel series by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichirou Otsuka . The series also announced 10 major projects for its 10th anniversary this year.

title: Uta Macross Rhythm Game Meets Crowdfunding Goal for Offline Version
content:
The crowdfunding campaign for Uta Macross , a "revival" version of the Macross franchise 's first rhythm game Uta Macross : Smartphone De Culture , reached its 30,000,000 yen (about US$190,000) goal within the first hour of launching on September 10, and also reached all of its initial stretch goals. The stretch goals fund an unspecified console version of the game, as well as additional songs. The campaign has since added two more stretch goals to expand the included art book to include all art, and to offer "multiple console versions."

As of press time, the campaign has raised 114,015,515 yen (about US$735,300). The campaign will run until October 31.

The company describes the upcoming game:

Uta Macross is a rhythm game featuring singers and pilots from across the Macross franchise . Players can enjoy numerous classic songs that have helped define the franchise , featuring characters from The Super Dimension Fortress Macross , Macross Plus , Macross 7 , Macross Frontier , and Macross Delta , including characters from their respective TV series and theatrical films. While carrying over popular content from its previous live service version, including live performances and artwork, the game is being rebuilt for release on Steam , iOS, and Android.

The game was initially announced for release on iOS, Android, and PC via Steam , but the campaign's first stretch goal adds a planned console release later. (The specific platform has not been announced.)

The original game's smartphone controls will be redesigned to also offer mouse and keyboard support, in addition to offline play.

The standard edition of the revived game will feature 50 songs, over 1,000 4-star-or-higher rarity Plate illustrations to win and collect, over 20 outfits for each singer, and a "completely free-to-play" gacha system for the Plates. Multiple DLCs will add the remaining songs from the live service version of the game, as well as select additional Plates and outfits.

The original Uta Macross : Smartphone De Culture ( Uta Mac ross Sumaho De Culture) game launched on iOS and Android in August 2017, delayed from its previously planned spring 2017 debut. The game ended service in June 2022. The game featured the "tactical music unit" Walkūre from Macross Delta and other Macross series characters such as Sheryl Nome and Ranka Lee. The title was the "first super-dimensional rhythm game" in the Macross franchise and featured various popular songs from the world of Macross .
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Ninth Ending Featuing "Suberidai" by Mori Tsubasa
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its ninth ending, featuring the song “Suberidai” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 102-114, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fifth opening, featuring the song “last cross” performed by Masami Mitsuoka . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: Sword Art Online Author Reki Kawahara's Devils' Crest Anime Casts 4 Classmates
content:
The official website for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series, announced the cast members for four classmates of the protagonist Yuma Ashihara on Wednesday:

Yūsuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo, a student council member and soccer club captain

Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono, the top girl in the class hierarchy

Rie Murakawa as Kai Kisanuki, a seemingly timid yet keenly observant student

Sora Amamiya as Sumika Watamaki, who is like a popular idol among the boys

Yen Press licensed the novels, and it describes the story:

The latest VRMMORPG, Actual Magic, has sealed an entire class of sixth graders in a terrifying game of life or death. Countless dangers await eleven-year-old Yuuma and his friends. One of their classmates has been turned into a monster, and gargantuan beasts lurk around every corner. Their only hope? The demon Valac who has possessed Yuuma's twin sister. Following Valac's guidance, Yuuma and his party set out to save their missing friend, Nagi. But an unexpected encounter awaits them...

The anime will star:

• Haruka Shiraishi as Yuma Ashihara

• Konomi Inagaki as Sawa Ashihara

• Yūya Hirose as Kenji Kondō

• Satomi Amano as Minagi Sano

Shinji Ushiro ( Yōkai Watch , Mazica Party , Scum of the Brave ) is the anime's chief director at Production I.G , and Kenichirō Komaya ( Nina the Starry Bride , Kizuna no Allele ) is directing the anime. Eiji Umehara ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- scripts, series composition for Suicide Squad ISEKAI ) is overseeing the series scripts, and the original novels' illustrator Yukiko Horiguchi is designing the characters. Yūki Hayashi ( My Hero Academia , Haikyu!! ) and Naoyuki Chikatani ( Ya Boy Kongming! live-action series and film, I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons anime) are composing the music. Ado performs the opening theme song "Shinka" (Evolution).

The anime will premiere worldwide on November 6 on Amazon Prime Video .

Kawahara launched the series with the first novel volume in November 2022. Kadokawa released the fourth novel volume in December 2025. Yen Press released the third novel volume in English in December 2025. Tomoe (art) and Koroku Takano (script) launched a vertical-scrolling manga adaptation of the novels in Wit Studio 's vertical-scrolling manga service HykeComic in November 2022. Kadokawa released the manga's first compiled book volume in June 2024.

Kawahara is best known for his Sword Art Online novels, which he began in 2001, and serialized from 2002 to 2008 on his website. Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko label began publishing a newly-edited print version in 2009, ending the original story with the "Alicization" arc as Kawahara had wrote it on his website with the 18th volume in 2016. The novel series returned with an all-new "Moon Cradle" story arc in 2017, and another all-new "Unital Ring" story arc in 2018, and is now in its 28th overall volume. The series has inspired novel and manga spinoffs, a television anime adaptation with several seasons, an anime film, and proposed live-action series . Kawahara's Sword Art Online: Progressive spinoff novel series inspired two anime films of its own.

Kawahara also penned the Accel World novel series, which inspired its own manga adaptations, a television anime adaptation, and an anime film. He also penned The Isolator: Realization of Absolute Solitude light novel series. Yen Press is releasing Sword Art Online , Accel World , and The Isolator: Realization of Absolute Solitude novels in English.

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 Announces January 10 Debut, Half-Year Run
content:
The official website for the third television anime season based on Katarina 's Shangri-La Frontier web novel series revealed on Wednesday the season's new key visual, January 10 premiere, and a broadcast run of two continuous cours (quarter of a year) on MBS , TBS and 26 affiliated channels at 5:00 p.m. JST (3:00 a.m. EST). The key visual features the tagline "Konton ga Hazeru." (Chaos erupts).

Kodansha USA Publishing publishes Ryōsuke Fuji 's manga adaptation of Katarina 's Shangri-La Frontier web novel, and it describes how the story begins:

Second year high school student Rakurō Hizutome is interested in one thing only: finding "shitty games" and beating the crap out of them. His gaming skills are second to none, and no game is too bad for him to enjoy. So when he's introduced to the new VR game Shangri-La Frontier , he does what he does best—min-maxes and skips the prologue to jump straight into the action. But can even an expert gamer like Rakurō discover all the secrets that Shangri-La Frontier hides...?

The cast returns from the second season to reprise their roles.

Toshiyuki Kubooka ( Harukana Receive , Wandering Witch - The Journey of Elaina ) serves as chief director for the new season at C2C with Hiro Ōki (episode director for Shangri-La Frontier ) as the director and Naoki Kotani (episode director for Black Clover , Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal II ) as assistant director. Kazuyuki Fudeyasu ( Black Clover , Dropkick on My Devil! , Hetalia The Beautiful World , In the Land of Leadale , Record of Ragnarok ) returns to oversee and write the scripts. Ayumi Kurashima ( DEVILMAN crybaby , Megalobox 2: Nomad ) is back as character designer and chief animation director. MONACA composes the music again.

Other staff members include:

• Sub-Character Designer: Riku Takizawa

• Monster Design: Yoshihiro Nagamori, Hiroshi Arisawa, Naoya Sonoda

• Prop Design: Yūki Yokoyama

• Action Effects Director: Satoshi Sakai

• Action Animation Director: Takeshi Nishino, Kazunori Osawa, Rino Isago, Mitsuke Watanabe

• Color Key Artist: Masato Takagi, Sakiko Teguramori

• Art Setting: Yuki Shigekawa

• Art Director: Chiho Wada

• 3D CG: Heartbeat

• CG Producer: Kiyoshi Nishida

• CG Director: Hiroyuki Kimura

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hikaru Yamaoku, Misako Ōtsu

• 2D Works: Azusa Tamura

• Special Effects: Kei Ishibashi

• Editor: Gō Sadamatsu

• Sound Director: Akiko Fujita

Crunchyroll will stream the new season.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 on 28 MBS / TBS networks. The anime aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

The anime's second season premiered in October 2024 and ran for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streams an English dub .

Katarina debuted the novel series on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Be Novelists) website in May 2017. Katarina also wrote an additional novel series in Weekly Shōnen Magazine .

Fuji launched the Shangri-La Frontier manga in Weekly Shōnen Magazine in July 2020.

The Shangri-La Frontier ~Nanatsu no Saikyō-shu~ ( Shangri-La Frontier ~The Seven Colossi~) game will launch this year. Netmarble Nexus is developing the franchise 's first game.

title: France's Ankama Presents Fantasy TV Anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar
content:
A website opened on Wednesday for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama which will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT). The website also presented the anime's key visual, main cast, and staff members.

The anime's story centers on a country boy named Welsh, and a prince destined to become a king named Shedar. The two boys are from different stations in life, but their destinies intertwine when they try to end a tyrant's plot to conquer the world.

The anime will star:

Rikuya Yasuda as Welsh, a 16-year-old boy who lives in Broccoli village, and is good at cooking

Yūki Kaji as Shedar, the 16-year-old prince of Bonta, the greatest country of the realm

Naoki Horiuchi (episode director for Kingdom second season, Black Clover , Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- ) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Saori Nakashiki ( Sasaki and Peeps , Tales of Wedding Rings ) is designing the characters, and Nakashiki is also one of the chief animation directors alongside Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Date A Live IV ) and Yuki Ikeda ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! (movie trilogy) .

Eri Suzuki ( Black Summoner ) is the color key artist, and Studio Massket is also in charge of anime background art. Lucas Cisterne (3D CG for The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is in charge of art setting, Jun Watanabe ( Ascendance of a Bookworm ) is directing the sound at TO Books , and Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli are composing the music. Tot is credited for the original work, scripts, and drafting the series story outline. Kenichi Yamashita ( MF Ghost ) is in charge of the series scripts for the anime's Japanese version.

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.
